summary_1line: Maricha recounts his past attack on Rama and the terror it left in him, urging Ravana to abandon his plan against Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maricha in the form of a deer charges at Rama in the forest while Rama releases three lightning-like arrows from his drawn bow.
Terrified Maricha flees through the Dandaka forest as Rama’s arrows streak behind him and his two demon companions fall slain.
Maricha, now an ascetic, trembles in the forest imagining Rama in every tree, the entire woodland filled with countless visions of Rama holding his bow.
